//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"debug/pe"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

type windowsPlatform struct{}

func init() { newPlatform = func() (platform, error) { return windowsPlatform{}, nil } }

func (windowsPlatform) Preflight() (map[string]any, error) {
	version := windows.RtlGetVersion()
	var processMachine, nativeMachine uint16
	if err := windows.IsWow64Process2(windows.CurrentProcess(), &processMachine, &nativeMachine); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if runtime.GOARCH != "arm64" || nativeMachine != pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64 || processMachine != pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_UNKNOWN {
		return nil, errors.New("fixture requires a native ARM64 controller on Windows ARM64")
	}
	if version.MajorVersion != 10 || version.BuildNumber < 26100 || version.ProductType != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("fixture requires Windows 11 24H2 or newer workstation; got %d.%d build %d product %d", version.MajorVersion, version.MinorVersion, version.BuildNumber, version.ProductType)
	}
	return map[string]any{"windows_build": version.BuildNumber, "native_machine": nativeMachine, "controller_arch": runtime.GOARCH, "go_version": runtime.Version()}, nil
}

func (windowsPlatform) ListenControl(ctx context.Context) (net.Listener, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	config := net.ListenConfig{Control: func(network, address string, raw syscall.RawConn) error {
		if network != "tcp4" {
			return fmt.Errorf("control listener requires tcp4, got %q", network)
		}
		var socketErr error
		err := raw.Control(func(socket uintptr) {
			// SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE must precede bind; SO_REUSEADDR cannot replace it.
			// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winsock/so-exclusiveaddruse
			socketErr = windows.SetsockoptInt(windows.Handle(socket), windows.SOL_SOCKET, -5, 1)
		})
		return errors.Join(err, socketErr)
	}}
	listener, err := config.Listen(ctx, "tcp4", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(err, listener.Close())
	}
	return listener, nil
}

type controlEndpoint struct {
	IP   [4]byte
	Port uint16
}

func controlEndpointFromAddr(address net.Addr) (controlEndpoint, error) {
	tcp, ok := address.(*net.TCPAddr)
	if !ok || tcp == nil || tcp.Zone != "" || tcp.Port < 1 || tcp.Port > 65535 || tcp.IP.To4() == nil || !tcp.IP.IsLoopback() {
		return controlEndpoint{}, fmt.Errorf("control endpoint is not concrete IPv4 loopback: %v", address)
	}
	return controlEndpoint{IP: [4]byte(tcp.IP.To4()), Port: uint16(tcp.Port)}, nil
}

const controlTCPTableCapacity = 1 << 20

func readControlTCPTable(query func([]byte, *uint32) uint32) ([]byte, uint32, error) {
	table := make([]byte, controlTCPTableCapacity)
	size := uint32(len(table))
	if status := query(table, &size); status != 0 {
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("GetExtendedTcpTable: %w", syscall.Errno(status))
	}
	if size < 4 || size > uint32(len(table)) {
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("TCP owner table returned invalid size %d", size)
	}
	return table, size, nil
}

func verifyControlTCPTable(table []byte, returned uint32, local, remote controlEndpoint, pid uint32) error {
	if pid == 0 || returned < 4 || uint64(returned) > uint64(len(table)) {
		return errors.New("TCP owner table has invalid bounds or process ID")
	}
	count := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(table[:4])
	// MIB_TCPTABLE_OWNER_PID starts rows at byte 4; each DWORD-aligned row is 24 bytes.
	// https://github.com/microsoft/win32metadata/blob/5c5efbc01d4c87f6830ec304d42777991d533154/generation/WinSDK/RecompiledIdlHeaders/shared/tcpmib.h#L124-L141
	if uint64(count) > uint64(returned-4)/24 {
		return errors.New("TCP owner table row count exceeds its returned size")
	}
	matches := 0
	var state, owner uint32
	for index := uint32(0); index < count; index++ {
		row := table[4+int(index)*24 : 4+int(index+1)*24]
		rowLocal := controlEndpoint{IP: [4]byte(row[4:8]), Port: binary.BigEndian.Uint16(row[8:10])}
		rowRemote := controlEndpoint{IP: [4]byte(row[12:16]), Port: binary.BigEndian.Uint16(row[16:18])}
		if rowLocal == remote && rowRemote == local {
			matches++
			state, owner = binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(row[:4]), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(row[20:24])
		}
	}
	if matches != 1 || state != 5 || owner != pid {
		return fmt.Errorf("control peer ownership mismatch: rows=%d state=%d PID=%d expected=%d", matches, state, owner, pid)
	}
	return nil
}

type controlPeerOps struct {
	live  func() error
	pid   func() (uint32, error)
	table func() ([]byte, uint32, error)
}

func verifyLiveControlPeer(ctx context.Context, pid uint32, local, remote controlEndpoint, ops controlPeerOps) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := ops.live(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	actualPID, err := ops.pid()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if actualPID != pid || pid == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("retained process handle PID %d differs from owned PID %d", actualPID, pid)
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	table, size, err := ops.table()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := verifyControlTCPTable(table, size, local, remote, pid); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := ops.live(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return ctx.Err()
}

var getExtendedTCPTable = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("iphlpapi.dll").NewProc("GetExtendedTcpTable")

func (p *windowsChild) VerifyControlPeer(ctx context.Context, conn net.Conn) (map[string]any, error) {
	if conn == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("control connection is missing")
	}
	local, err := controlEndpointFromAddr(conn.LocalAddr())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	remote, err := controlEndpointFromAddr(conn.RemoteAddr())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	p.processMu.Lock()
	defer p.processMu.Unlock()
	if p.process == 0 || p.process == windows.InvalidHandle {
		return nil, errors.New("owned process handle is closed")
	}
	err = verifyLiveControlPeer(ctx, p.pid, local, remote, controlPeerOps{
		live: func() error {
			wait, err := windows.WaitForSingleObject(p.process, 0)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if wait != uint32(windows.WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
				return fmt.Errorf("owned process is not live: wait=%d", wait)
			}
			return nil
		},
		pid: func() (uint32, error) { return windows.GetProcessId(p.process) },
		table: func() ([]byte, uint32, error) {
			// The synchronous OS query is not cancellable; the caller checks its context on both sides.
			return readControlTCPTable(func(table []byte, size *uint32) uint32 {
				status, _, _ := getExtendedTCPTable.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&table[0])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(size)), 0, 2, 5, 0)
				return uint32(status)
			})
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return map[string]any{"transport": "tcp4", "local_address": conn.LocalAddr().String(), "remote_address": conn.RemoteAddr().String(), "owner_pid": p.pid, "tcp_state": 5}, nil
}

type windowsChild struct {
	job             windows.Handle
	processMu       sync.Mutex
	process         windows.Handle
	input           *ownedProcessInput
	output, stderr  *os.File
	launch          windowsLaunchFacts
	pid             uint32
	done            chan struct{}
	result          error
	exitObserved    bool
	processCloseErr error
	once            sync.Once
	finishErr       error
	forced          bool
}

type ownedProcessInput struct {
	pipe   io.WriteCloser
	closed atomic.Bool
	once   sync.Once
	err    error
}

func (p *ownedProcessInput) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	if p.closed.Load() {
		return 0, os.ErrClosed
	}
	return p.pipe.Write(data)
}

func (p *ownedProcessInput) Close() error {
	p.once.Do(func() {
		p.closed.Store(true)
		// Close must be able to interrupt a blocked Write; it never takes a write lock.
		p.err = p.pipe.Close()
	})
	return p.err
}

type windowsLaunchCall struct {
	OffsetNanos    int64  `json:"offset_ns"`
	DurationNanos  int64  `json:"duration_ns"`
	Returned       bool   `json:"returned"`
	Error          string `json:"error"`
	ErrorTruncated bool   `json:"error_truncated"`
}

type windowsLaunchFacts struct {
	RequestedImage       string             `json:"requested_image"`
	CommandLineUnits     int                `json:"command_line_utf16_units"`
	CommandLineSHA256    string             `json:"command_line_utf16le_sha256"`
	PID                  *uint32            `json:"pid,omitempty"`
	CreateProcess        *windowsLaunchCall `json:"create_process,omitempty"`
	AssignJob            *windowsLaunchCall `json:"assign_job,omitempty"`
	QueryImage           *windowsLaunchCall `json:"query_image,omitempty"`
	QueryMachine         *windowsLaunchCall `json:"query_machine,omitempty"`
	ResumeThread         *windowsLaunchCall `json:"resume_thread,omitempty"`
	PreviousSuspendCount *uint32            `json:"previous_suspend_count,omitempty"`
	ActualImage          string             `json:"actual_image,omitempty"`
	ProcessMachine       *uint16            `json:"process_machine,omitempty"`
	NativeMachine        *uint16            `json:"native_machine,omitempty"`
	CleanupConfirmed     bool               `json:"failed_start_cleanup_confirmed"`
}

type windowsLaunchError struct {
	Facts windowsLaunchFacts
	Cause error
}

func (e *windowsLaunchError) Error() string { return e.Cause.Error() }
func (e *windowsLaunchError) Unwrap() error { return e.Cause }

func observeWindowsLaunchCall(start time.Time, now func() time.Time, destination **windowsLaunchCall, operation func() error) error {
	entered := now()
	call := &windowsLaunchCall{OffsetNanos: entered.Sub(start).Nanoseconds()}
	*destination = call
	err := operation()
	call.DurationNanos, call.Returned = now().Sub(entered).Nanoseconds(), true
	if err != nil {
		call.Error = err.Error()
		if len(call.Error) > 512 {
			call.Error, call.ErrorTruncated = call.Error[:512], true
		}
	}
	return err
}

func checkWindowsResumeCount(count uint32) error {
	if count != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("owned primary thread resume returned previous suspend count %d; expected 1", count)
	}
	return nil
}

func observeWindowsImage(facts *windowsLaunchFacts, start time.Time, now func() time.Time, image func() (string, error), machine func() (uint16, uint16, error)) error {
	if err := observeWindowsLaunchCall(start, now, &facts.QueryImage, func() error {
		path, err := image()
		if err == nil {
			facts.ActualImage = path
		}
		return err
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return observeWindowsLaunchCall(start, now, &facts.QueryMachine, func() error {
		process, native, err := machine()
		if err == nil {
			facts.ProcessMachine, facts.NativeMachine = &process, &native
		}
		return err
	})
}

func (p *windowsChild) Input() io.WriteCloser           { return p.input }
func (p *windowsChild) Output() io.ReadCloser           { return p.output }
func (p *windowsChild) Errors() io.ReadCloser           { return p.stderr }
func (p *windowsChild) Done() <-chan struct{}           { return p.done }
func (p *windowsChild) PID() uint32                     { return p.pid }
func (p *windowsChild) Result() error                   { <-p.done; return p.result }
func (p *windowsChild) LaunchFacts() windowsLaunchFacts { return p.launch }

type jobAccounting struct {
	TotalUserTime, TotalKernelTime, PeriodUserTime, PeriodKernelTime int64
	PageFaults, TotalProcesses, ActiveProcesses, TerminatedProcesses uint32
}

func checkJobAccountingABI() error {
	var value jobAccounting
	offsets := [...]uintptr{unsafe.Offsetof(value.TotalUserTime), unsafe.Offsetof(value.TotalKernelTime),
		unsafe.Offsetof(value.PeriodUserTime), unsafe.Offsetof(value.PeriodKernelTime),
		unsafe.Offsetof(value.PageFaults), unsafe.Offsetof(value.TotalProcesses),
		unsafe.Offsetof(value.ActiveProcesses), unsafe.Offsetof(value.TerminatedProcesses)}
	if unsafe.Sizeof(value) != 48 || unsafe.Alignof(value) != 8 || offsets != [8]uintptr{0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 36, 40, 44} {
		return errors.New("job accounting differs from the 64-bit Windows ABI")
	}
	return nil
}

func readJobActive(query func(*jobAccounting, *uint32) error) (uint32, error) {
	if err := checkJobAccountingABI(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var accounting jobAccounting
	var returned uint32
	if err := query(&accounting, &returned); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if returned != uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(accounting)) {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("job accounting returned %d bytes; expected %d", returned, unsafe.Sizeof(accounting))
	}
	return accounting.ActiveProcesses, nil
}

func jobActive(job windows.Handle) (uint32, error) {
	return readJobActive(func(accounting *jobAccounting, returned *uint32) error {
		return windows.QueryInformationJobObject(job, windows.JobObjectBasicAccountingInformation,
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(accounting)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(*accounting)), returned)
	})
}

var errJobRundownDeadline = errors.New("owned job did not become empty within cleanup budget")

type jobRundownOps struct {
	now       func() time.Time
	active    func() (uint32, error)
	terminate func() error
	pause     func(time.Time) error
}

func waitOwnedJobEmpty(deadline time.Time, ops jobRundownOps) error {
	for {
		if !ops.now().Before(deadline) {
			return errJobRundownDeadline
		}
		active, err := ops.active()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !ops.now().Before(deadline) {
			return errJobRundownDeadline
		}
		if active == 0 {
			return nil
		}
		if err := ops.pause(deadline); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
}

func finishJobRundown(rootExited bool, deadline time.Time, ops jobRundownOps) (bool, error) {
	var original error
	if rootExited {
		original = waitOwnedJobEmpty(clampJobDeadline(ops.now().Add(5*time.Second), deadline), ops)
		if original == nil {
			return false, nil
		}
	}
	terminationErr := ops.terminate()
	confirmationDeadline := clampJobDeadline(ops.now().Add(5*time.Second), deadline)
	return true, errors.Join(original, terminationErr, waitOwnedJobEmpty(confirmationDeadline, ops))
}

func clampJobDeadline(candidate, deadline time.Time) time.Time {
	if candidate.After(deadline) {
		return deadline
	}
	return candidate
}

func pauseJobRundown(deadline time.Time) error {
	remaining := time.Until(deadline)
	if remaining <= 0 {
		return errJobRundownDeadline
	}
	interval := min(10*time.Millisecond, remaining)
	timer := time.NewTimer(interval)
	defer timer.Stop()
	<-timer.C
	return nil
}

func (p *windowsChild) Finish() (bool, error) {
	return p.FinishBefore(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
}

func (p *windowsChild) FinishBefore(deadline time.Time) (bool, error) {
	p.once.Do(func() {
		overall := clampJobDeadline(time.Now().Add(10*time.Second), deadline)
		rootExited := false
		select {
		case <-p.done:
			rootExited = p.exitObserved
		default:
		}
		p.forced, p.finishErr = finishJobRundown(rootExited, overall, jobRundownOps{
			now:       time.Now,
			active:    func() (uint32, error) { return jobActive(p.job) },
			terminate: func() error { return windows.TerminateJobObject(p.job, 1) },
			pause:     pauseJobRundown,
		})
		// The unnamed job handle is not inherited. Closing it is also the crash path.
		p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, windows.CloseHandle(p.job))
		waiterFinished := false
		select {
		case <-p.done:
			waiterFinished = true
		default:
		}
		if !waiterFinished {
			remaining := max(time.Duration(0), time.Until(overall))
			timer := time.NewTimer(remaining)
			defer timer.Stop()
			select {
			case <-p.done:
				waiterFinished = true
			case <-timer.C:
				p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, errors.New("owned process termination was not confirmed"))
			}
		}
		if waiterFinished {
			p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, p.processCloseErr)
		}
		p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, p.input.Close(), p.output.Close(), p.stderr.Close())
	})
	return p.forced, p.finishErr
}

func (windowsPlatform) Start(executable string, args []string, directory string) (_ child, resultErr error) {
	started := time.Now()
	facts := windowsLaunchFacts{RequestedImage: executable, CleanupConfirmed: true}
	defer func() {
		if resultErr != nil {
			resultErr = &windowsLaunchError{Facts: facts, Cause: resultErr}
		}
	}()
	if !filepath.IsAbs(executable) || !filepath.IsAbs(directory) {
		return nil, errors.New("owned process paths must be absolute")
	}
	application, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(executable)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	command, err := windows.UTF16FromString(windows.ComposeCommandLine(append([]string{executable}, args...)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	commandBytes := make([]byte, 2*len(command))
	for i, word := range command {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(commandBytes[2*i:], word)
	}
	facts.CommandLineUnits, facts.CommandLineSHA256 = len(command), fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(commandBytes))
	workingDir, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	job, err := windows.CreateJobObject(nil, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	owned := false
	defer func() {
		if !owned {
			err := windows.CloseHandle(job)
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, err)
			if err != nil {
				facts.CleanupConfirmed = false
			}
		}
	}()
	info := windows.JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION{}
	info.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE
	if _, err := windows.SetInformationJobObject(job, windows.JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&info)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(info))); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	childInput, parentInput, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer childInput.Close()
	defer func() {
		if !owned {
			parentInput.Close()
		}
	}()
	parentOutput, childOutput, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer childOutput.Close()
	defer func() {
		if !owned {
			parentOutput.Close()
		}
	}()
	parentError, childError, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer childError.Close()
	defer func() {
		if !owned {
			parentError.Close()
		}
	}()
	handles := []windows.Handle{windows.Handle(childInput.Fd()), windows.Handle(childOutput.Fd()), windows.Handle(childError.Fd())}
	for _, handle := range handles {
		if err := windows.SetHandleInformation(handle, windows.HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, windows.HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	attributes, err := windows.NewProcThreadAttributeList(1)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer attributes.Delete()
	if err := attributes.Update(windows.PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST, unsafe.Pointer(&handles[0]), uintptr(len(handles))*unsafe.Sizeof(handles[0])); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	startup := windows.StartupInfoEx{
		StartupInfo:             windows.StartupInfo{Cb: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(windows.StartupInfoEx{})), Flags: windows.STARTF_USESTDHANDLES, StdInput: handles[0], StdOutput: handles[1], StdErr: handles[2]},
		ProcThreadAttributeList: attributes.List(),
	}
	var process windows.ProcessInformation
	flags := uint32(windows.CREATE_SUSPENDED | windows.CREATE_NO_WINDOW | windows.CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT | windows.EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT)
	if err := observeWindowsLaunchCall(started, time.Now, &facts.CreateProcess, func() error {
		return windows.CreateProcess(application, &command[0], nil, nil, true, flags, nil, workingDir, &startup.StartupInfo, &process)
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	facts.PID, facts.CleanupConfirmed = &process.ProcessId, false
	defer windows.CloseHandle(process.Thread)
	// Assign before resuming so even immediate child creation remains job-owned.
	if err := observeWindowsLaunchCall(started, time.Now, &facts.AssignJob, func() error {
		return windows.AssignProcessToJobObject(job, process.Process)
	}); err != nil {
		terminateErr := windows.TerminateProcess(process.Process, 1)
		wait, waitErr := windows.WaitForSingleObject(process.Process, 5000)
		if waitErr == nil && wait != windows.WAIT_OBJECT_0 {
			waitErr = errors.New("unassigned suspended process termination unconfirmed")
		}
		closeErr := windows.CloseHandle(process.Process)
		facts.CleanupConfirmed = terminateErr == nil && waitErr == nil && closeErr == nil
		return nil, errors.Join(err, terminateErr, waitErr, closeErr)
	}
	p := &windowsChild{job: job, process: process.Process, input: &ownedProcessInput{pipe: parentInput}, output: parentOutput, stderr: parentError, pid: process.ProcessId, done: make(chan struct{})}
	owned = true
	go func() {
		wait, err := windows.WaitForSingleObject(process.Process, windows.INFINITE)
		p.processMu.Lock()
		if err != nil {
			p.result = err
		} else if wait != windows.WAIT_OBJECT_0 {
			p.result = fmt.Errorf("unexpected process wait result %d", wait)
		} else {
			p.exitObserved = true
			var code uint32
			if err := windows.GetExitCodeProcess(process.Process, &code); err != nil {
				p.result = err
			} else if code != 0 {
				p.result = fmt.Errorf("owned process %d exited with code %d", p.pid, code)
			}
		}
		// The waiter owns this handle until its final wait and exit-code query complete.
		p.processCloseErr = windows.CloseHandle(process.Process)
		p.process = 0
		p.result = errors.Join(p.result, p.processCloseErr)
		p.processMu.Unlock()
		close(p.done)
	}()
	p.processMu.Lock()
	imageErr := observeWindowsImage(&facts, started, time.Now, func() (string, error) {
		if p.process == 0 {
			return "", errors.New("owned process handle closed before image query")
		}
		buffer := make([]uint16, 32768)
		size := uint32(len(buffer))
		if err := windows.QueryFullProcessImageName(p.process, 0, &buffer[0], &size); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if size == 0 || size >= uint32(len(buffer)) {
			return "", errors.New("owned process image path has invalid length")
		}
		return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer[:size]), nil
	}, func() (uint16, uint16, error) {
		var processMachine, nativeMachine uint16
		err := windows.IsWow64Process2(p.process, &processMachine, &nativeMachine)
		return processMachine, nativeMachine, err
	})
	p.processMu.Unlock()
	if imageErr != nil {
		_, finishErr := p.Finish()
		facts.CleanupConfirmed = finishErr == nil
		return nil, errors.Join(imageErr, finishErr)
	}
	if err := observeWindowsLaunchCall(started, time.Now, &facts.ResumeThread, func() error {
		count, err := windows.ResumeThread(process.Thread)
		facts.PreviousSuspendCount = &count
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return checkWindowsResumeCount(count)
	}); err != nil {
		_, finishErr := p.Finish()
		facts.CleanupConfirmed = finishErr == nil
		return nil, errors.Join(err, finishErr)
	}
	p.launch = facts
	return p, nil
}
